name: position_privacy_auth
description: Position sharing privacy modes per spec Section 18.1. Public/group/private mode auth requirements.

modes.public: No auth required, anyone can read
modes.group: Group OSCORE required, group members only
modes.private: Pairwise OSCORE required, specific peer only

vectors.name: public_no_auth_accept
vectors.description: Public position: unauthenticated GET is accepted.

vectors.name: public_auth_also_accepted
vectors.description: Public position: authenticated request also accepted.

vectors.name: group_no_auth_reject
vectors.description: Group position: unauthenticated GET is rejected.

vectors.name: group_member_accept
vectors.description: Group position: group member with OSCORE is accepted.

vectors.name: group_non_member_reject
vectors.description: Group position: non-member with valid OSCORE is rejected.

vectors.name: private_no_auth_reject
vectors.description: Private position: unauthenticated GET is rejected.

vectors.name: private_wrong_peer_reject
vectors.description: Private position: valid OSCORE from wrong peer is rejected.

vectors.name: private_correct_peer_accept
vectors.description: Private position: pairwise OSCORE from allowed peer is accepted.

vectors.name: mode_switch_immediate
vectors.description: Mode change takes effect immediately for subsequent requests.

vectors.name: position_beacon_follows_mode
vectors.description: Position in beacons follows privacy mode setting.
